visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt with a blue tie and a grey pleated skirt, stands in a large exhibition hall. She is positioned next to a massive pink bear cardboard cutout wearing a red bellhop suit and hat. She smiles at the camera, pointing toward the red booth behind her while the background shows a busy industrial-style ceiling with pipes and track lighting. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of the brand logo '小小 PETIT' and the booth location code 'K3-019'. The camera then pans across a tiered red display stand filled with dozens of small, colorful nail polish bottles arranged neatly in rows. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant colors of the products. (3) Shots show the behind-the-scenes setup of the booth. Staff members in white t-shirts are seen tying thick red ropes and organizing cardboard boxes. A worker on a ladder adjusts the overhead lighting while another staff member works at a laptop. The girl in the school uniform is seen interacting with the displays and posing for selfies. (4) The main creator and another girl in a matching uniform pose together, making 'V' signs and smiling at the camera. They are standing in front of a red wall featuring promotional text and QR codes. The hall is crowded with other booths and visitors in the distance. (5) Final wide shots capture the completed booth, which features a red and white striped circular counter and various product displays. The overall atmosphere is energetic and bright, with the red color scheme dominating the visual field.

Subtle ambient room tone from the large hall is audible but does not interfere with the clear vocal signal. The music maintains a consistent major-mode tonality, keeping the mood positive and active. (5) The track concludes with a clear call to action, with the voice maintaining a high level of clarity and energy until the final sentence.
